description: 112年度1731條土石流潛勢溪流圖 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 112年度1731條土石流潛勢溪流圖包含ID(編號)、Debrisno(土石流潛勢溪流編號)、County01(主要所在縣市)、Town01(主要所在鄉鎮市區)、Vill01(主要所在村里)、County02(第二所在縣市)、Town02(第二所在鄉鎮市區)、Vill02(第二所在村里)、Name(溪流名稱)、Mark(地標)、Roadn... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 8 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
